deadline_ms.description:
Optional caller deadline in milliseconds, valid in `1..=u32::MAX`.

The field is a wide signed integer so ordinary below- and above-range values deserialize and reach request validation, which owns the one closed range every client surface shares.

visibility.description: Visibility tiers requested by the caller.

FreshnessPolicy.description: Behavior when a requested live source cannot complete.

oneOf.description: Fail when every requested source cannot complete.
Retain a bounded degraded result when live data is unavailable.

VisibilityMode.description: Visibility tiers included in one immutable Oracle query cut.

oneOf.description: Read pinned Iceberg and hot sealed files.
Also read the exact fenced live-tail interval.
